description: NASA's Mars rovers side by side and to scale in 3D: Sojourner (1997), Spirit and Opportunity (2004), Curiosity (2012) and Perseverance (2021). Hover a dot for a camera, instrument, solar panel, RTG, antenna or computer: what it does, its mass and power where a source states them, and a link to the source. Beside it, mass and power across the generations (a hundred times heavier, seven times the power) and where the watts go (MOXIE and Ingenuity drew more than the MMRTG makes). Caveats: shapes are simplified and positions approximate, not NASA's models; figures are from Wikipedia's rover and instrument pages; empty mass or power means no stated figure. Next: the raw images example shows what the cameras see today.
name: Mars rovers up close
